verdict.rationale: Kit documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents execute natural-language prompts like 'draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week' as real account actions, backed by read/write access to a creator's Kit account and a live docs MCP to avoid hallucinated API surfaces. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no detail on the breadth of natural-language commands supported beyond the broadcast example.
